name: wait-workspace
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(n=>n.textContent.trim()==='Estimate');if(n){o.disconnect();clearTimeout(t);resolve(true)}};const o=new MutationObserver(check);o.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true});const t=setTimeout(()=>{o.disconnect();reject(Error('Workspace did not hydrate'))},45000);check()})
